duosight.unavailable: That player is already paired, or you selected yourself.
duosight.invitation: %s invited you to share their body and inventory. You start as %s, swapping every %s seconds. Stand nearby to accept.
duosight.no_invite: No active invitation. Ask your partner to invite you again.
duosight.start_conditions: Both players must be unpaired, alive, on foot, in Survival, and within 32 blocks in the same dimension.
duosight.started: Be My Eyes started. Roles swap every %s seconds. The control-book key opens settings; F8 ends the session.
duosight.stopped: Session stopped. Your normal controls have been restored.
duosight.disconnected: Session ended because a partner disconnected.
duosight.died: Session ended because the shared body died.
duosight.inactive: You are not sharing a body.
duosight.status: Sharing a body. Swap interval: %s seconds. Next swap in %s seconds.
duosight.interval_set: Swap interval set to %s seconds. Countdown restarted for this session only.
duosight.swap_loading: The shared body is changing dimensions. Wait until loading finishes.
duosight.book.received: You received a Be My Eyes control book. Open it or press %s.
duosight.book.shortcut: Press %s to open the Be My Eyes control book. Both roles can use it; change the key in Controls.
duosight.book.full: Your inventory is full. Use the control-book key or /bemyeyes book; use /bemyeyes book give once you have space.
duosight.book.give_active: Use the control-book key during a session. Physical books are removed when play starts.
duosight.book.give_disabled: Physical books are no longer granted after your first session starts. Press %s to open settings.
duosight.book.role_set: Your next invitation starts you as %s. Your body and inventory will still be shared.
duosight.book.role_active: Initial roles are chosen before inviting. Use Swap now to switch the current roles.
duosight.book.interval_set: Your next invitation will use a %s-second swap interval.
